analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates straightening her thick curly hair against humidity using a steam straightener brush.
analysis.full_description: A creator sits in front of the camera styling her naturally curly dark hair using an orange steam straightener brush (Steambrush Pro). She glides the brush through a section of hair, instantly making it sleek, smooth, and resistant to humidity, with a side-by-side comparison of curly vs. straightened sides, concluding with a full reveal of her glossy, voluminous straightened look.

on_screen_text.text: Why did nobody tell me a steam straightener would make my curly hair not suck up the humidity outside and get poofy again?

scenes.visual: Creator sitting in a bedroom/living area with curly hair sectioned, gliding the orange steam straightener brush slowly through a strand.
scenes.action: Creator straightens one section, smoothing it with her hand behind the brush, then turns to show the straight, silky strand next to her voluminous curly hair.

scenes.visual: Creator working on top sections of her hair near the crown and front bangs.
scenes.action: Creator runs the steam straightener through her crown section, checking the smoothness and smiling slightly at the camera.

scenes.visual: Creator showing the final complete hair look.
scenes.action: Creator smiles, sways her shoulders, showing off sleek, shiny, blowout-styled dark hair with soft curved ends.

hook.first_frame: Creator holding an orange steam hair straightener brush gliding through curly brown hair with text overlay.
hook.visual_0_3s: Slow, satisfying pass of the heated steam brush turning textured curly hair into a glossy straight sheet in a single stroke.
hook.text_0_3s: Why did nobody tell me a steam straightener would make my curly hair not suck up the humidity outside and get poofy again?
hook.pattern_interrupt: Instant transformation of curly, frizzy hair into sleek glass-like straight hair with visible steam action.

narrative_beats: Relatable hook calling out humidity and curly hair struggles
Half-and-half side comparison of sleek straight vs. curly poof
key_claims: Steam straightener prevents curly hair from sucking up humidity outside and getting poofy
pain_points: Humidity causing straightened curly hair to poof and frizz up
objections_handled: Can it handle coarse, thick curly hair in one pass?
structure.comparison_to: Traditional dry straighteners that fail against humidity

talent.hair_before: Thick, dark brunette, naturally curly and wavy with frizz
talent.hair_after: Ultra-smooth, glossy blowout style with rounded ends and no frizz

audio_and_edit.music_description: Upbeat pop song with energetic female vocals playing continuously.
audio_and_edit.ending: Final beauty pose showcasing the completed blowout result.

analysis.notes: Classic organic-style UGC text-overlay format targeting women with curly and frizz-prone hair in humid climates.
